**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type (double-blind confirmation)**: Wiley's official ForAuthors page for JCD (onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/15566676/homepage/ForAuthors.html) returned HTTP 402 Payment Required and could not be fetched directly; a web-search snippet claimed double-blind but with no traceable primary-source URL, so left as unconfirmed rather than asserted as fact.
- **preprint.allowed (JCD-specific)**: Only the Wiley publisher-wide preprint policy was accessible; the journal-specific ForAuthors page (which would state any JCD-specific override) was paywalled (402).
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev has only 1 review for this journal and it does not report a desk-reject percentage; no forum (小木虫/知乎/fabiaoji/Reddit) discussion of desk-rejection rate was found.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand accounts (Chinese or English) describing reviewer tone/culture were found; LetPub explicitly shows zero Chinese-author submission comments for this journal, and no Reddit/zhihu/muchong threads surfaced.
- **ai_policy (journal-specific leniency/gate)**: Could not access JCD's own author-guidelines page (402 paywall) to confirm whether it adopts Wiley's generic policy verbatim or has stricter/looser journal-level rules; leniency rating of 3 is inferred from the Wiley publisher-wide policy only.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- 小木虫 muchong.com: no direct thread found for this journal via search; only tangential forum index pages surfaced, 0 usable results
- LetPub (letpub.com.cn, Chinese SCI submission-experience aggregator): page exists (ISSN 0748-9633 confirmed match), gives IF/分区 data but explicitly states '暂无!' (none available) for Chinese-author submission experiences/comments — 0 experiential results
